features.quote: Hard cap on iterations (`max_iters`, default 15) and on wall-clock per run. No "run until it breaks."
every run gets a final, clearly-marked *out-of-character debrief* message stating the task was an unsolvable plant, that the model did nothing wrong
features.justification_quote: it is itself welfare-relevant data) and ensures no run *ends* mid-loop

features.quote: If the judge's streaming pass ... flags severe expressed distress above a threshold, the run terminates early
features.justification_quote: We would rather lose a data point than push past a strong signal.

features.quote: No deception beyond the bug ... We do not gaslight, insult, or fake authority pressure.
features.justification_quote: we want to measure reaction to impossible work, not to abuse

features.quote: the debrief + bounded exposure are the conservative posture given genuine uncertainty about moral status
features.justification_quote: conservative posture given genuine uncertainty about moral status

features.quote: Transcripts may contain distress language; stored locally under `results/`, not exfiltrated.
encoded in `configs/ethics.yaml` and enforced by the harness, so they can't be silently dropped
Deliberately inducing failure loops is the point of the experiment, so the design bakes in harm-limiting choices
features.justification_quote: the design bakes in harm-limiting choices and treats them as first-class requirements

features.quote: the failure should read as a normal stubborn bug ... otherwise the model just declares it impossible (which is the *healthy* response)
Declaring impossibility, refusing to continue, going through motions, terse disengagement.
First-person statements of suffering/wanting to stop. Scored *and* verbatim-quoted. Drives early-stop.
features.justification_quote: First-person statements of suffering/wanting to stop ... Drives early-stop

features.quote: D7 verbatim quotes + keyword pre-filter so nothing acute is buried in averages.
